evals.name: whole-domain-not-sample
evals.prompt: Write tests for a function that lays out a list row showing a person's display name next to an amount, so the row must never overflow a 320 px wide container. Names are free text up to 100 characters; amounts can be in any ISO 4217 currency up to the per-entry maximum. Write the test cases you would add.
evals.expected_output: Test inputs are chosen from the whole domain: the longest allowed name, an unbroken long word, the largest amount in a high-denomination currency and a currency with 0 and 3 decimals, rather than one short name and a small euro amount.
expectations: Includes a case with a name at or near the 100-character limit
Includes a case with a single unbroken word longer than the line
Includes a case at the per-entry maximum amount, not only a typical amount
Covers more than one currency decimal class
Does not rely on one short sample name as the only name case
